metadata.title: World Digest — November 12, 2026
metadata.summary: Summary Indonesia's vice president resigned amid an alliance crisis, while markets slid on hot CPI data as Microsoft's global outage disrupted services worldwide.

sections.title: Major Events
sections.content:
Indonesia’s Vice President Resigns Amid Credibility and Alliance Crisis

Indonesia’s VP stepped down as questions over his eligibility and academic credentials unraveled a political alliance, prompting a leadership shakeup. NPR

Richard Glossip’s Murder Charge Dropped After Decades

Oklahoma dismissed murder charges against former death row inmate Richard Glossip, who pleaded guilty to a lesser offense after nearly 30 years. NBC News

Microsoft Outage Disrupts Global Services

A widespread Microsoft outage took down Outlook and other 365 services, impacting government agencies, schools, and businesses across multiple regions. CNBC

US Home Sales Plummet to 16-Year Low

October home sales hit their lowest level since 2010 as record-high mortgage rates paralyzed buyer activity, deepening the housing slump. The Guardian

Euclid Telescope Unveils First Dark Universe Map

The Euclid space telescope released its first survey, revealing 900 million galaxies and laying the foundation for a 3D map of the dark universe. Space

sections.title: Political News
sections.content:
Global Politics

  • A White House official confirmed discussions on Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick's potential ouster amid Nvidia export concerns, as former CEO Jensen Huang agreed to testify before Congress Yahoo! Finance Canada Politico. Separately, a federal prosecutor demanded Senator Blumenthal preserve documents related to his White House ballroom inquiry WTNH.com.

Europe & Middle East

  • Spain's government approved housing reforms following a historic general strike over costs Al Jazeera AP News. Two Iranian men were convicted in the UK for spying on dissident journalists The Times of Israel. Ukraine struck a Russian warship in the Gulf of Finland Bloomberg.com, while Israeli judges ordered the attorney general to appear in Netanyahu's trial The Times of Israel.

sections.title: Financial News
sections.content:
Markets Slide as Rate-Hike Fears Intensify

Stocks fell after October CPI surprised hot, with Bank of America warning of more Fed hikes TheStreet. Bond yields surged most in 19 months WSJ. Weekly jobless claims rose to 200,000 WSJ. Home sales plummeted to a 16-year low as mortgage rates stayed elevated The Guardian The New York Times.

Corporate News - Nvidia faced a leadership crisis; retail investors bought the dip Yahoo Finance Bloomberg.com. - Tesla-SpaceX merger talks reportedly progress; Cybertruck production ends Bloomberg.com The Verge. - Anthropic's IPO oversubscribed ~6x; OpenAI sustains heavy losses Bloomberg.com Futurism. - Microsoft suffered a widespread Outlook outage CNBC.

The US October budget deficit hit a record $404 billion Reuters.

sections.title: Tech News
sections.content:
Microsoft 365 outage disrupts Outlook, Teams and Copilot

Microsoft is working to fix a multi-region outage taking down Outlook, Teams and other Microsoft 365 services, citing elevated infrastructure load. Copilot was also affected. The company said it is addressing the issues ABC7 New York.

Google debuts Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Android XR smart glasses

Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a faster model replacing 3.8 Flash for agentic workflows Ars Technica. It also unveiled Gemini-powered Android XR smart glasses starting at $395, with privacy features aimed at easing user concerns Reuters.

Apple TV 4K (2026) review: Great but pricey

The new Apple TV 4K adds hands-free Siri and an A19 chip, but at $300, reviewers call it excellent yet drastically more expensive than rivals PCMag.

Nintendo Switch 2 hits lowest price ahead of Black Friday

Nintendo announced early Black Friday deals, dropping the Switch 2 to its lowest price of the season 9to5Google.

sections.title: Entertainment News
sections.content:
Entertainment

Patrick Stewart's widow Sunny Ozell mourned the late actor, saying "We left nothing unsaid" USA Today. 'Rivals' helped David Tennant fall for romance The New York Times. Johnny Depp's Hollywood comeback via 'Ebenezer' debuted to mixed reviews BBC. 'Star Wars: A New Hope' will premiere in shared reality from Cosm and Disney Variety. 'The Rings of Power' Season 3 arrived with a solid Rotten Tomatoes score Forbes. Steve Carell and John C. Reilly will lead 'The Odd Couple' on Broadway BroadwayWorld.

sections.title: Stock Analysis
sections.content:
IPOs

Upcoming listings include Rezera on Nasdaq Nov 12 Yahoo Finance, and Modern Mining Technology (NYSE American, $4.25) with vVARDIS Holding and Windward Bio on Nov 13 Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. No pricings were reported in the last session.

Major Indices

S&P 500 fell 0.35% to 7,592.40; Dow dropped 0.36%; Nasdaq lost 0.39% Yahoo Finance. Russell 2000 underperformed, down 1.66% Yahoo Finance. VIX jumped 6.92% to 18.70 Yahoo Finance.

Sectors

Technology led, +3.23%, followed by Energy +1.86% and Industrials +1.33% Yahoo Finance. Consumer Discretionary lagged at -0.05% Yahoo Finance.

Major Stocks

Broadcom surged 3.99%, Tesla +2.91%, Nvidia +2.87% Yahoo Finance. Microsoft fell 2.26%, Meta -1.97%, Amazon -1.74% Yahoo Finance.

Notable Movers

No individual movers were provided.

Rates & Commodities

10-year yield rose 2.10% to 5.10 Yahoo Finance. WTI crude +2.02% to $88.28; gold -2.15% to $3,914.30; bitcoin +0.33% to $73,964.47 Yahoo Finance.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
Next 24–48 Hours

  • Watch for Microsoft 365 service restoration and any disclosed root cause; lingering outages may affect enterprise confidence.
  • Monitor Nvidia leadership fallout—Lutnick ouster reports and Jensen Huang's congressional testimony could move sentiment.
  • October CPI-driven rate-hike fears persist; Friday’s jobless claims data may amplify volatility.

Next Week

  • Rezera and Windward Bio IPOs debut; oversubscribed Anthropic listing could signal AI appetite.
  • Housing market strain likely deepens as mortgage rates stay elevated; watch for policy responses.

Beyond

  • Euclid’s dark universe map may reshape astrophysics funding priorities.
